Backups

No backup key has been set up yet. Without a key the server does not create backups.

Backups are encrypted with a key pair. The server only gets the public key and therefore cannot read the backups itself. The secret key is stored in the backup folder, protected by your passphrase. Without passphrase and key no backup can be restored.

Store the secret key safely now: in a password manager and printed in a safe. It is shown only this once.
